items.title: International Business Machines Corp's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: International Business Machines Corp (NYSE:IBM) recently announced a total dividend of $1.69 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-10.  This includes a $1.69 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-10.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
